minutes.headline: Task force approved its stormwater warrant article for special town meeting by unanimous roll call.
minutes.summary: The Stormwater Task Force held a brief remote meeting mainly to accept town counsel's minor edits to its warrant article for the upcoming special town meeting and to vote it through by roll call. The remainder of the meeting was spent scheduling presentations to FinCom, the Select Board, and a public information session before the November 17 town meeting, and planning what those presentations (including budget/funding-mechanism comparisons) will cover.

what_happened.line: The task force voted unanimously by roll call to accept its stormwater warrant article, with town counsel's edits, for the special town meeting.
The approved article is to go out that night to town staff for filing ahead of the meeting.
Members are working to schedule presentations to FinCom, the Select Board, and a public information session before the November 17 town meeting.
The next task force meeting, September 21, will finalize what those presentations say about the budget and the funding-mechanism options.

why_it_matters: This sends a stormwater program to a warrant article residents will vote on at the November 17 special town meeting.
How the program is funded -- a utility-style fee versus a blended approach -- changes how costs split between the town, commercial and industrial properties, which can show up as a bill.
FinCom and Select Board presentations, still being scheduled, are where that funding-mechanism choice gets debated before the vote.
